title: Build truncated Fe model
action: From crystal structure of [Fe^III L^•_3] (CCDC 668633), remove isopropyl groups to create a truncated model for DFT; save initial coordinates.
description: Construct a computationally tractable model of the Fe complex by deleting isopropyl substituents from the experimental crystal structure.

title: DFT optimization and analysis of Fe complex
action: Perform broken-symmetry BS(5,3) B3LYP geometry optimization on the truncated Fe model, then compute C–O and C–C bond lengths, Mulliken spin populations (Fe and each ligand), and number of alpha and beta singly occupied orbitals. Write results to fe_complex_results.json.
description: Scored output for Fe complex containing optimized geometry, bond lengths, spin populations, and singly occupied orbital counts.
output_schema: JSON object with required keys: geometry (array of {symbol, x, y, z} in Angstrom), bond_lengths ({C-O_avg, C-C} in Angstrom), mulliken_spin_fe (float), mulliken_spin_ligands (array of 3 floats), num_alpha_singly_occupied (int), num_beta_singly_occupied (int).

title: Prepare Ni complex model
action: From crystal structure of [Ni^I L^•(cod)] (CCDC 668632), prepare initial coordinates for DFT optimization.
description: Extract and pre-process the Ni complex coordinates from the deposited CIF for subsequent DFT calculations.

title: DFT optimization and analysis of Ni complex
action: Perform broken-symmetry BS(1,1) B3LYP geometry optimization on the Ni complex, then compute C–O and C–C bond lengths, Mulliken spin populations (Ni and diketonate ligand), and number of alpha and beta singly occupied orbitals. Write results to ni_complex_results.json.
description: Scored output for Ni complex containing optimized geometry, bond lengths, spin populations, and singly occupied orbital counts.
output_schema: JSON object with required keys: geometry (array of {symbol, x, y, z} in Angstrom), bond_lengths ({C-O_avg, C-C} in Angstrom), mulliken_spin_ni (float), mulliken_spin_ligand (float), num_alpha_singly_occupied (int), num_beta_singly_occupied (int).
